title: Logout returns success and retains authentication cookies on a provider sign-out error
blast: Shared-browser logout can leave the previous member or staff session usable: the UI accepts HTTP 200 and redirects while both Supabase auth-cookie chunks remain.
evidence: app/api/auth/logout/route.ts:30-51; components/portal/SignOutButton.tsx:20; installed @supabase/auth-js 2.101.1 src/GoTrueClient.ts:3730-3746 returns provider 503 before local session removal. Raw red regression: graph/evidence/clm_secrets_logout_retains_session.txt
verify: npx vitest run --config graph/evidence/secrets-run_20260909_1730.vitest.config.mts -t 'logout clears local authentication'

title: Soft-deleted accounts with surviving provider sessions retain member API access
blast: When provider disable fails after the application soft-delete, existing sessions still read member profile data. The deletedAt login guard does not revoke sessions already signed in; shared getUser and GUC bootstrap also continue recognizing the identity.
evidence: app/api/admin/members/[id]/delete/route.ts:100-118 explicitly retains deletedAt on Auth disable failure; lib/auth/server.ts:101-115 and :164-178 omit deletedAt; app/api/member/profile/route.ts:18-26 returns that deleted row; app/api/auth/login/route.ts:145-175 checks deletedAt only during login. Raw red regression: graph/evidence/clm_secrets_deleted_session_still_authorized.txt

title: Enforced staff MFA permits admin API access before initial factor enrollment
blast: A password-authenticated administrator can skip the setup-MFA destination and directly reach admin APIs before enrolling any factor. Role checks still apply, but the mandatory second factor is bypassed.
evidence: middleware.ts:382-407 gates only aal1/aal2 and passes aal1/aal1; app/api/auth/login/route.ts:179-190 requires setup for unenrolled staff after creating their session; app/api/admin/members/route.ts:12-18 checks user/role only; installed @supabase/auth-js 2.101.1 src/GoTrueClient.ts:5442-5461 leaves nextLevel=aal1 when no verified factor exists. Raw red regression: graph/evidence/clm_secrets_mfa_unenrolled_admin_bypass.txt
verify: npx vitest run --config graph/evidence/secrets-run_20260909_1730.vitest.config.mts -t 'enforced MFA rejects admin API'
